notes: Scope: native Trezor Suite application, including user-facing flows in suite-native-app modules and suite-native/module-earn; SDK examples, Storybook, developer utilities and internal services are excluded.
Mobile observations are source-backed, not runtime verification. No native build, simulator or physical device was used; no new screenshots were captured.
Desktop/web fields are deliberately unknown in this evidence inventory; merge these records with the desktop inventory before making platform parity claims.
Manual E2E scenarios are declared skipped test records with prerequisites, steps and TestStream metadata. They represent a QA checklist, not proof of execution or current release availability.

Several older manual scenarios still use Suite Lite labels, Customization/Localization or My Assets navigation; current screen composition uses Settings > Preferences and the current Accounts/Home surfaces.

No screen-brightness, homescreen-image, haptics, screen-rotation or wipe-code configuration control was found in the current native DeviceSettingsScreen subtree; do not copy desktop device-settings parity to mobile.

USB transport is phone/platform dependent; Bluetooth requires a compatible device and permissions. Device onboarding and firmware actions are model/feature-gated; T1B1 no-firmware manual scenario explicitly directs the user to desktop.

The staking product descriptors give the Everstake ETH/Hoodi and SOL/devnet products mobile access 'manage' and every Cardano, Tron and external Solana product 'read-only'. Do not claim native ADA/TRX staking creation, unstake or claim parity.
SendOutputFields has an explicit TODO for adding outputs; the data structure supports an array but current mobile UI does not provide an Add recipient control.

The native swap provider sheet exposes all/CEX/DEX filtering and groups floating/fixed offers, automatically sorted by best rate. Manual trading-offers-selection describes optional KYC and fee sorting controls which were not confirmed in the implementation.
Suite Sync availability is selected through feature state and device capability, not the generic experimental toggle list; current user-facing experimentalFeatures.ts lists slip24.

Standalone Wrap entry is development-gated; standalone Unwrap is available for eligible wrapped-native token accounts without that dev-utils gate. Both remain feature/firmware gated, and wrap/unwrap steps also exist in supported yield flows. The manual wrap test requires development mode and firmware 2.12.4 or newer; validate live rollout before showing it as generally available.

TestStream is treated as an ownership clue only. Sparse CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns native send/assets to Suite Wallet and authorization/passphrase packages to @juriczech; other product-team assignments remain inferred.
No seed words, private keys, passphrases, PINs, account addresses, balances, transaction IDs or user labels were copied into the inventory.

All native manual E2E test files have a source disposition. Developer feature-flag, splash smoke and storage-upgrade tests are reviewed but excluded as independent user features. Native automated top-level E2E flows are all linked as scenario evidence.
The account AssetPriceCard shows current price and daily change; the separate asset-detail AssetDetailPriceSection composes the actual historical price chart.
Native forgetting supports disconnected remembered devices; factory reset starts from Bootloader mode and requires installed firmware.
